newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. debt futures close lower in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. debt futures close lower in light trade.

text.p: March 18 - Most U.S. debt futures closed lower in light trade. Late long liquidation pushed June T-bonds to 108-21/32. Traders said one firm started selling 1,500 contracts at 108-25/32, which helped push June to the 108-21/32 area. Traders are awaiting U.S. Feb consumer prices at 0830 EST/1330 GMT on Wed. Overall, core CPI seen up 0.2 pct.
